slides.title: Eritrea takes its case to UN officials

source: Source: Dawan Africa, citing an Eritrean government text, Nov 26-27, 2026

card.title: Ethiopia is “set to launch a massive war of aggression.”
card.body: Claim by Eritrea's information minister Yemane Gebremeskel to senior UN officials in Asmara, published Nov 26. Unverified. PM Abiy told parliament the same week Ethiopia would not invade for Red Sea access.
